## Network Diagrams

This appendix is comprised of network diagrams illustrating where the [Application] infrastructure resides and connects with other network devices. Diagrams are current as of time of document submission.

The accompanying Visio workbooks are as follows:

The Visio Workbooks contain several pages with diagrams of network and application related items deployed for the Medi-Cal environment. The first picture in each workbook, entitled “Instructions,” contains all diagrams and guidelines on using the workbook.

The Visio workbook has been built utilizing a feed from the Gainwell Configuration Management Database (CMDB). This information has been linked to various Visio images. To view the CMDB data, select the Data tab and the Shape Data Window checkbox as shown in the diagram below.

1. Viewing CMDB Data in Visio

![](data:image/png;base64...)

When a component that has CMDB data is selected, a new dialog box will open, similar to the one shown below.
